messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Message ERROR that stop the App - HELP
parts:
Shiny apps that are deployed on a server are not compatible with tcltk.  Shiny is presuming that the UI is an html UI.  Tcltk starts up its own UI.  When you run an app with tcltk locally it works because it has access to the underlying graphics display and can start the UI.  When you run such an app on the server, the application doesn't have access to the UI.  

I don't know enough about the packages you are using but you might be able to get the UI you need by using Shiny instead of relying on the package with a custom tcltk UI.
